title: Sales Profiles Comparison
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners reveal the five CEB sales profiles, compare their share of star performers in complex sales using verified research data, and answer three questions with one attempt each.

learningObjectives: Compare the five sales profiles (Relationship Builder, Hard Worker, Lone Wolf, Reactive Problem Solver, Challenger) and identify which profile correlates with high performance in complex sales.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Guided exploration with research data, followed by a quiz
keyQuestions: Compare the five sales profiles (Relationship Builder, Hard Worker, Lone Wolf, Reactive Problem Solver, Challenger) and identify which profile correlates with high performance in complex sales.
commonMisconceptions: Relationship Builders are the highest performers.
Hard Workers achieve the best results through effort alone.
All profiles can achieve the same results.
assessmentOpportunities: 3 of 3 quiz questions correct on the first attempt.
Learner can explain why Relationship Builders underperform in complex sales.
